Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR OSTEOTOME. 
WHITCHURCH HOWELL'S PATTERN 



o 

f 

O 



1. Scope — Prescribes dimensional and other requirements of Whitchurch Howell's pattern osteotome 
used in orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 . 



DIA 2S 




-SHARP EDGE 



A - 2a 30, 40 or 50 

Ail dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 OSTEOTOME, WHITCHURCH HOWELL'S PATTERN 
2.1 Deviations in millimetres on dimensions shall be permitted as given below : 

± 0*5 mm on dimensions below 5 mm 
±10 mm on dimensions above 5 and up to 10 mm 
± 1'5 mm On dimensions above 10 and up to 50 mm 
4: 2 mm on dimensions above 50 and up to 100 mm 
t 3 mm on dimensions above 100 and up to 200 mm 
± 5 mm on dimensions above 200 mm 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to designation 30Cr13 or 40Cr13 of 18:6603-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel bars and flats'. 



4. Heat Treatment 

470 to 550 A/l^. 



The osteotome shall be evenly hardened and tempered.to give a hardness of 



5. Workmanship — All the surfaces of the osteotome f hall be free from pits, burrs, and grinding 
marks. The cutting edge of the instrument shall be properly sharpened and shall be free from burrs, 
feathers, nicks and waviness. All other edges shall be even. 

6. Finish — The instrument shall be electro-polished arid passivated. 

?• Performance Test — The osteotomes shall be held firmly with the cutting edge vertically 
downward on a piece of hard and dryjsheep bone. 200 full blows on the head with a 500-g hammer 
shall then be applied. On completion of the test, head shall not become mushroom shaped. The 
cutting edge shall not show any sign of damage or loss of cutting efficiency and the shank shall not 
show any deformation. 

8. Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the instrument in accordance with 15:7531-1975 'Method 
for boiling and eut6daving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

9. Marking — Shall i3N» legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name or initials or 
recogni?!ed trade-mark, and with the words 'Stainless stee^. 

9,1 tSI Certif (cation Marking •— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, 

10. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
